all.text: At this latitude, the Earth's spin carries the ship east at about 660 mph, whatever the captain is doing.
The sun reaches its highest point here at almost the same moment as in Southampton.
Drill straight through the Earth from here and you'd surface at 50.6°S, 179.0°E, about 820 km from Dunedin.
This far north, they're roughly level with Vancouver, even though it's a world away.
The seabed is roughly 32 m below the ship.
